Your data in GoPlan

Updated 17 October 2026. This explains the current GoPlan pilot. The website supports personal accounts and cloud roadmap syncing.

University inquiries

The contact form saves your name, work email, organization and message for the GoPlan team to respond. Inquiries are retained for up to 180 days and removed on a later inquiry or owner review. They are not sent to the planning AI. Only authenticated GoPlan owners can read the inquiry list.

University pilot access

Contracted pilots can restrict access to a university-provided list of approved institutional emails. The access list stores hashes scoped to that university, rather than readable roster addresses. Removed students lose access on their next request, including during an existing session. Their saved work is retained under the account storage rules below. Pilot accounts are separate from university accounts. The public AUI demo accepts personal email accounts.

Your personal GoPlan account

Verify your email using a one-time code and provide your first and last name to create a GoPlan profile. Then create a password for future sign-ins. Supabase handles email verification and password storage; GoPlan does not store your password. Password recovery requires a new email code; GoPlan stores your account identifier and email. A secure sign-in cookie remembers your session for up to 30 days, unless you sign out or delete your GoPlan data. This identifies your account; it does not verify that you are an AUI student. After you agree to cloud saving, GoPlan stores your profile, questionnaire answers, roadmaps, course progress, grades and notes to restore your work across browsers and devices. Names are used for your welcome and account display, not academic recommendations.

Your account data remains until you delete it. In Account you can edit your name, download your account data, sign out or permanently delete your cloud profile and roadmaps. The owner dashboard lists registered names, emails, joining dates and last activity dates; it does not display your roadmap, grades or questionnaire. Authorized service operators may access stored data to maintain the service.

Device copies and shared computers

GoPlan keeps a local copy of your signed-in workspace, including unsynced edits, to recover interrupted saves. Wait for “Saved to your account” before switching devices. Conflicting edits are kept for your review instead of silently overwriting a plan. Sign out on a shared computer: GoPlan clears this account’s cached workspaces from that browser. Signing out does not erase separately downloaded backups or older device-only plans.

Existing device-only plans are attached to an account only when you choose to import them. Clearing browser storage removes local copies. The service includes one roadmap per account; you can edit that roadmap after saving.

When you ask the AI adviser

The adviser receives your questionnaire, academic choices and relevant change requests. Later changes also include course codes, statuses and semesters. The app excludes your name, sign-in email, exact GPA, grades and private progress notes from these requests. A yes/no indicator of accelerated-load eligibility may be included. Free text is sent as written. Avoid personal or sensitive information in free-text answers. GoPlan sends the necessary request to OpenAI to generate advice using GPT-6.1 Sol. Focused discovery and evidence extraction use GPT-6 Luna. Live research uses OpenAI’s web search and the server reads consulted public source pages. Requests set store to false. Research receives a smaller set of public-topic interests and change preferences, with email addresses and phone numbers removed; search instructions exclude identity, grades and private progress notes. Provider handling is described in OpenAI’s API data handling documentation. Recommendations need your review and do not confirm live course availability or AUI approval.

Request protection

Temporary server locks prevent overlapping paid adviser requests. They contain an opaque account/session hash, a random lock token and a short expiry, never your answers or roadmap. They are removed after the request or expire after the request deadline plus 30 seconds (currently 210 seconds), with expired locks cleaned on later requests.

Your service allowance

Each account includes one roadmap, two AI change prompts in each of five guided stages, and five global AI change prompts after saving. Unused stage prompts do not carry over. Submitted prompts use an allowance even if no change is accepted or a request fails. Manual editing and Excel export remain available afterward. GoPlan stores per-account counters and private response receipts to enforce this allowance across devices and avoid charging twice for the same request. Receipts are removed when you delete your GoPlan data. A hashed account reference, used allowance counters and action identifiers remain to prevent allowance resets; they contain no email, name, answers or AI response text.

Small, private usage totals

GoPlan records daily counts of adviser operations, success and failure, response times, provider calls and reported token usage. It also counts plan saves, accepted updates and Excel requests. These aggregate counters contain no student identifiers, names, questionnaire answers, grades or plan contents. Local previews are excluded. Counters older than 90 days are deleted on the next measurement write. They cannot be traced back to a particular student, so there is no individual usage record to export or delete. Hosting and AI providers may separately process operational data under their own policies.

Optional mistake reports

Reports go to the GoPlan team only when you choose to submit them. Your report text and degree, focus and minor identifiers are included; your questionnaire, name and grades are not attached. Reports and reviews expire after 90 days and are removed on the next report operation. Use “Your workspace → My mistake reports” in the same browser and roadmap to withdraw them earlier. Management uses a private receipt stored in that browser; receipts do not sync across devices. A verified correction is shared with future AI requests only if you opted in; this does not retrain the underlying model. Keep sensitive details out of reports.

Who can access this information?

Device copies can be accessed by someone who controls your browser or unlocked device. Cloud roadmap requests require the signed-in account that owns them. The team’s online usage dashboard and report-review endpoints require the owner’s authenticated account. The private operator terminal also supports a separate administrator credential. Review decisions record the reviewer and their explanation. For questions during this pilot, contact the GoPlan teammate who invited you. Account deletion does not withdraw separate mistake reports; withdraw reports in the original browser and roadmap before deleting your account if you want both removed.

Sign-in service

Supabase and the configured email-delivery service process your email and authentication messages. Password setup uses a five-minute HttpOnly verification cookie and a single-use hashed verification record; completing setup or recovery revokes prior GoPlan sessions. GoPlan keeps a hashed session token and temporary hashed rate-limit records to operate sign-in. Session records expire after 30 days; expired sessions and rate-limit records are removed on a later sign-in operation. Signing out revokes that GoPlan session. Deleting your GoPlan data revokes all its sessions and removes the profile and cloud plans; the authentication provider may retain its separate account and operational records. Contact the GoPlan team for help with those records.
